password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.instructions: We received a request to reset your password. Click the link below to choose a new password. This link will expire in 60 minutes.
password_reset.footer: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

invitation.subject: You have been invited to BS CMS
invitation.instructions: You have been invited to join BS CMS. Click the link below to accept your invitation and create your account. This link will expire in 7 days.
invitation.footer: If you were not expecting an invitation, please contact your administrator.

verify_email.subject: Verify your email address
verify_email.instructions: Please verify your email address by clicking the link below. This link will expire in 24 hours.
verify_email.footer: If you did not request this verification, please contact support.

email_changed_notice.subject: Security notice: Your email address was changed
email_changed_notice.instructions: Your account email address was changed. If you performed this action, no further steps are needed.
email_changed_notice.alert: If you did NOT perform this action, please contact your administrator immediately to secure your account.

new_login_notice.subject: Security notice: New sign-in detected
new_login_notice.instructions: A new sign-in to your account was detected from the IP address and device below.
new_login_notice.footer: If this was you, you can safely ignore this email. If not, change your password immediately.

two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication enabled
two_factor_enabled.instructions: Two-factor authentication has been successfully enabled on your account.
two_factor_enabled.footer: Keep your recovery codes in a secure location.

test_email.subject: Test email from BS CMS
test_email.instructions: This is a test email sent from your BS CMS installation. If you are reading this, your email configuration is working properly!
test_email.footer: Sent by BS CMS Email Subsystem.
